plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
runtime: node 22, express, better-sqlite3; eight apps (gateway, maps, food, img, yt, audio, text, docs)
contracts: openvibe-contracts v0.63.0 (each app's package.json; the root package.json pins none)
deployment: Public at https://openvibe.tools: deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy tools` (OpenVibe.Host strategy multi-app since the 2026-09-27 cutover; deploy/scripts/deploy.sh is the wrapper), /opt/openvibe.tools, units openvibe-tools (gateway, 127.0.0.1:4001) and openvibe-tools-<app> per satellite, env /etc/openvibe/tools.env.
features: tool registry with descriptors, canonical hosts, aliases and owner-attached custom domains
server-rendered catalog and tool pages with full SEO
public registry API (tools.tool.read) and run API (tools.tool.run)
jobs runtime for img, audio and docs with SSE progress and Media results
net and dev tools on the gateway; maps, food, img, yt, audio, text and docs satellites
guard: callers, tiered quotas, upload sniffing, SSRF-safe egress, abuse log
